## Problem

What are you trying to do that the app makes hard or impossible today? Describe the
merchant workflow, not just the feature.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to see. Keep in mind the preview-gate, before-value, and undo
guarantees — a proposal must not bypass them.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why they fall short.

## Scope check

The following are explicit non-goals in [`docs/PRD.md`](../../docs/PRD.md); please confirm
your request is not one of them:

- [ ] Not editing orders, customers, inventory, collections, images, or SEO fields
- [ ] Not App Store billing or pricing plans
- [ ] Not scheduled or recurring edits
- [ ] Not multi-store sync
- [ ] Not metafields in CSV (UI edit set only)
- [ ] Not multi-currency / price-list editing
- [ ] Not redo or undo of arbitrary historical jobs
- [ ] Not REST Admin API usage

## Additional context

Any mockups, examples from other tools, or links that clarify the request.
